pages.text: Trinkets worn in Curios slots (necklace, body, charm, ring). The two necklaces share one slot, and so do the two charms, so pick.

pages.text: Necklace. Breathe underwater and mine at normal speed underwater.

pages.text: Charm. Food fills 50% more, and you heal while standing on honey or honeycomb.
